about: modules/git G-ORACLE mutants: hermetic environment isolation, deterministic fixed-clock timestamps, NUL-delimited (-z) plumbing parsing, and typed transcript comparison.

mutants.name: git-oracle-inherits-ambient-config
mutants.rule: HermeticEnv isolates C Git from ambient HOME/.gitconfig, global config, attributes, and ambient identity overrides.

mutants.name: git-oracle-uses-wall-clock
mutants.rule: HermeticEnv pins GIT_AUTHOR_DATE and GIT_COMMITTER_DATE to the deterministic step epoch rather than wall-clock time.

mutants.name: git-oracle-drops-z-nul-parse
mutants.rule: NUL-delimited (-z) plumbing parsers split records on NUL bytes rather than newlines.

mutants.name: git-oracle-compare-ignores-oid
mutants.rule: CompareTranscripts compares Final.HeadOid and reports typed mismatches on differing repository outcomes.

mutants.name: git-root-reverses-config-scope
mutants.rule: Config scope precedence orders System < Global < Local < Worktree < Command so Local overrides Global.

mutants.name: git-root-ignores-commondir
mutants.rule: Discover resolves commondir for linked worktrees rather than returning GitDir as CommonDir.

mutants.name: git-root-ignores-unknown-extension
mutants.rule: Discover rejects unknown extensions.* under repositoryformatversion = 1 with UnsupportedExtension.

mutants.name: git-root-follows-untrusted-include
mutants.rule: LoadConfigFiles does not follow include.path directives when TrustPolicy.AllowIncludes is false.

mutants.name: git-oid-omits-nul
mutants.rule: Canonical Git object headers terminate `<kind> <size>` with a NUL byte before payload bytes.

mutants.name: git-oid-normalizes-crlf
mutants.rule: HashObject hashes raw object payload bytes without CRLF/line-ending conversion.

mutants.name: git-oid-accepts-uppercase-hex
mutants.rule: ParseHex enforces strict canonical lowercase hex and rejects uppercase hex digits.
